message:
## Vulnerability Digest

**Scan window:** 2026-11-05 05:10 IST to 2026-11-06 05:10 IST

Five relevant advisories or material updates were verified in the last 24 hours for the deduplicated primary product scope. Immediate review is recommended for the OpenSSH authentication bypass and the Cisco Nexus exposure update.

### OpenSSH — CVE-2026-123158

- **Severity:** High, CVSS 8.1 (GitHub Advisory Database; record marked unreviewed)
- **Affected:** OpenSSH before 10.6p2 on Linux systems using musl libc with PAM disabled.
- **Description:** A remote, unauthenticated attacker may bypass password authentication in certain account configurations by supplying a password of a specific excessive length.
- **Relevance:** OpenSSH is explicitly monitored. The OpenSSH project describes 10.6p2 as a critical security workaround.
- **Sources:** [OpenSSH release notes](https://www.openssh.org/releasenotes.html#10.6p2), [GitHub advisory](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-4fcc-vm97-gx3x), [CERT-FR alert](https://www.cert.ssi.gouv.fr/alerte/CERTFR-2026-ALE-015/)

### Cisco Nexus 9000 standalone NX-OS Guest Shell — Node.js/Brotli vulnerabilities

- **Issues:** CVE-2026-111497, CVE-2026-105482, CVE-2026-105483, CVE-2026-106069
- **Severity:** High, Cisco CVSS base score 7.4
- **Description:** Cisco's November 5 update confirms that standalone Nexus 9000 NX-OS Guest Shell is affected by a group of Node.js/Brotli issues involving potential remote code execution, DNS truncation, and TLS hostname-validation bypass.
- **Relevance:** Cisco Nexus is explicitly monitored; Cisco lists this exact Nexus product family as impacted. Cisco reported proof-of-concept code but no known malicious use against Cisco products.
- **Source:** [Cisco security advisory](https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/content/CiscoSecurityAdvisory/cisco-sa-oct2026-node-js-Jj3SQ19u)

### Microsoft Edge — November Chromium vulnerability rollup

- **Issues:** CVE-2026-118309, CVE-2026-118314, CVE-2026-118321, CVE-2026-119260 through CVE-2026-119272, CVE-2026-122518, and CVE-2026-76024 through CVE-2026-76031
- **Severity:** Not clearly stated in the consolidated CERT-FR advisory.
- **Affected:** Microsoft Edge before 156.0.4314.58.
- **Description:** The rollup addresses multiple Chromium-derived memory-safety, input-validation, reference-resolution, integer-overflow, and out-of-bounds-read issues; reported impacts include possible confidentiality loss and other unspecified security effects.
- **Relevance:** Microsoft Edge is explicitly monitored.
- **Source:** [CERT-FR advisory](https://www.cert.ssi.gouv.fr/avis/CERTFR-2026-AVI-1466/)

### MongoDB drivers and tools — multi-vulnerability consolidation

- **Issues:** CVE-2022-30636, CVE-2024-45337, CVE-2025-11575, CVE-2025-22874, CVE-2026-19502, CVE-2026-120952, CVE-2026-120953, CVE-2026-120959, CVE-2026-76794, CVE-2026-76797, CVE-2026-76798
- **Severity:** Not clearly stated as a single rating in the consolidated advisory.
- **Affected:** MongoDB Database Tools before 100.20.1; Entity Framework before 9.0.5 or 10.0.5; C Driver before 1.30.15 or 2.5.8; ODBC Driver before 3.0.1; Rust Driver before 3.10.0.
- **Description:** CERT-FR consolidated vendor disclosures covering remote code execution, denial of service, security-policy bypass, and confidentiality or integrity impact.
- **Relevance:** MongoDB is explicitly monitored, and the affected drivers and official tools are part of the mandatory MongoDB ecosystem scope.
- **Source:** [CERT-FR advisory](https://www.cert.ssi.gouv.fr/avis/CERTFR-2026-AVI-1462/)

### nginx on older Ubuntu releases — USN-8955-2

- **Issues:** CVE-2026-42533, CVE-2026-15176, CVE-2026-93479, CVE-2026-97205
- **Severity:** Not stated in the Ubuntu notice.
- **Affected:** Ubuntu nginx packages on 20.04 LTS, 18.04 LTS, 16.04 LTS, and 14.04 LTS.
- **Description:** Canonical extended nginx fixes to older Ubuntu releases and added CVE-2026-42533, involving crafted configurations or requests that may cause denial of service or possibly arbitrary code execution.
- **Relevance:** Both nginx and Ubuntu are explicitly monitored.
- **Source:** [Ubuntu USN-8955-2](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8955-2)

### MongoDB ecosystem sweep

The dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, mongod, mongos, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, mongosh, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and libraries, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, and official integrations. The driver/tool consolidation above was retained; no additional fresh, credible MongoDB Server, Atlas, Compass, mongosh, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Kubernetes Operator, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, or official-integration finding was verified in the window.

**Closing:** Prioritize checking musl-based OpenSSH servers and standalone Nexus 9000 Guest Shell deployments. Review Edge, MongoDB client/tooling, and older Ubuntu nginx package versions against the affected ranges. Date-only November 4 reports whose primary disclosures could not be placed confidently inside the exact window were excluded.
